meta.title: L.A.B. DF3 Putter Covers — Embroidered & Magnetic | Sunday Rolls Golf
meta.description: Embroidered putter covers made for the L.A.B. DF3 and DF3i and other center-shafted mallets. Magnetic closure, velvet lining, $80. Designed in the USA.

header.title: L.A.B. DF3 Putter Covers
header.subtitle: Embroidered covers cut for the DF3's center shaft, with a magnetic closure and a soft velvet lining.

intro: Most mallet covers are built for heel-shafted putters, so they leave a center-shafted putter's neck hanging out. Every cover here has its opening in the middle, made for the L.A.B. DF3 and DF3i and other center-shafted mallets of a similar size.
Each one is embroidered with an original Sunday Rolls design, from the Retro Roller to The Birdie Machine, and closes with a magnet so it stays on in the bag.

faq.question: Will these covers fit my L.A.B. DF3?
faq.answer: Yes. Every cover on this page is made for the L.A.B. DF3 and also fits the DF3i, with the opening in the center for the shaft. They fit other center-shafted mallets of a similar size too.

faq.question: Will a regular mallet cover fit a DF3?
faq.answer: Usually not. Standard mallet covers, like our Spider mallet covers, have the opening at the heel, which leaves a center-shafted putter's neck exposed. Choose a center-shaft cover for the DF3.

faq.question: How big are the DF3 covers?
faq.answer: About 4.625 in. long and 5 in. wide.

faq.question: How do they close, and what's inside?
faq.answer: A magnetic closure keeps the cover on, and a soft velvet lining protects the putter's finish from scratches and dings.

faq.question: What are they made of?
faq.answer: Most have a PU (synthetic leather) outer with embroidered artwork. The Corduroy uses corduroy and Sunday Stripes uses seersucker.

faq.question: Can I return a cover?
faq.answer: Yes. You can return it within 30 days of receiving it for a full refund of the purchase price. Return shipping is paid by you.

header.title: L.A.B. Oz.1 & Mezz.1 Putter Covers
header.subtitle: Embroidered covers contoured for L.A.B.'s Oz.1 and Mezz.1 center-shaft putters.

intro: The L.A.B. Oz.1 and Mezz.1 are smaller than a DF3, so a DF3 cover leaves them loose. These covers are contoured for the Oz.1 (OZ1i) and Mezz.1 center-shaft models.
Each one carries an original Sunday Rolls design, closes with a magnet and has a soft velvet lining to protect the putter.

faq.question: Which L.A.B. putters do these fit?
faq.answer: The L.A.B. Oz.1 (OZ1i) and Mezz.1 center-shaft models. They don't fit the heel-shafted (HS) versions.

faq.question: Can I use a DF3 cover on my Oz or Mezz?
faq.answer: It will be loose. The DF3 covers are sized for the larger DF3 head, so an Oz or Mezz cover is the better fit.

faq.question: How big are the Oz & Mezz covers?
faq.answer: About 3.25 in. long and 4.25 in. wide.

faq.question: How do they close, and what's inside?
faq.answer: A magnetic closure keeps the cover on, and a soft velvet lining protects the putter's finish from scratches and dings.

faq.question: Can I return a cover?
faq.answer: Yes. You can return it within 30 days of receiving it for a full refund of the purchase price. Return shipping is paid by you.
